resources.string: Draw anything you like on the paper with the pencil. Choose its color and thickness in Colors.
Paint brush: paint inside a shape with your finger. The paint stays inside the lines; on empty paper it paints wherever you go.
Paint bucket: tap inside a shape and that spot is filled with your color. Hold for 2 seconds to paint the whole shape.
See the pieces of your picture (lines, shapes, words); you can hide or delete them.
Choose the pencil\'s color, thickness and type.
Ready pictures and shapes: pick one and tap the paper to place it.
Changes the color of the paper.
How thick the paint brush is: thin, medium or thick.
Pick the Pencil at the top and slowly trace the dashed line with your finger.
You can also use the paint brush: pick Paint, choose the color and paint inside the area with your finger. The paint stays inside the lines!
With the pencil you draw anything you like. Look, I\'m drawing a bright sun in the sky!
